blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte affirmed on Tuesday that it is not in the character of Vice President Sara Duterte, his sister, to ask for favors in rewarding government contracts to corporations. Baste Duterte testified during the cross examination of the vice president’s lawyer Justin Nicol Gular, who confronted him on whether or not Sara Duterte ever intervened with matters involving the Davao City. “Being the brother of the vice president herself, and having known her for years, do you think that it is in her character as a person as a politician to request for any […]...
